title: Conversation system
description:
The backend will be mainly used by chat clients for delivering a conversation experience (e.g. via Telegram but in the future via different clients). We want those clients to remain dumb and for the backend to drive the whole conversation logic.
This means that we need to create a series of conversation flows and the appropriate endpoints for them, that clients will be able to access so that they can send messages to their users and get the right responses.
We need to make it so that the flows can prompt the user for action, in which case there will either be:
- an answer to select from from a predefined list where each option can take the user to a different part of the flow or start a new flow
- a series of answers to provide either from pre-selection or free-flow text, at the end of which the flow can continue
- a free text answer that for a given flow will be constrained to some continuation flows that will result from it
In most cases, whenever there's free text input, we also need to provide error handling messages in case the input is misunderstood/wrong.
In the future we also want a complete free text input starter endpoint - the user will provide text, which our backend can parse (with the help of an LLM) and decide which flow should be started. We must be careful to provide appropriate error handling in case messages are misunderstood so the user has a good experience. This can be implemented as one of the last features.

There are already a few flows already present that must be implemented:
- a start flow for non-authenticated users so that they provide their app-secret + access-code
- a setup profile flow for authenticated users to provide their profile info (timezone REQUIRED)
- an update profile flow for updating any of the profile fields
- a create goal flow that is initiated by the user by providing text input, that will lead to the user getting multiple goal suggestions, an option to redefine input, and to initiate a continuation flow to pick a goal from a set of suggested options.
- create goal flow for sound input, leading to the above text input, but after extra confirmation to see if the message was understood correctly
- create goal flow from predefined options, going through type, category, intensity and finally showing the user the options to pick from
- a goals flow, that will show the user all the sub-flows that lead to creating a goal (for now: text input, sound input, predefined options)
- a checkins flow, that allows a user to see their checkins and configure them
- a start flow for authenticated users, listing all possible main flows a user can take, so for now the update profile flow, goals flow and checkins flow

features.title: Create Conversation Module and Persistence Layer
features.description: Create a new `conversations` module in `src/conversations`. Set up the necessary repository, service, and controller stubs. Define the interfaces for conversation state and create a new DynamoDB table definition for `UserConversationState` in `src/database/tables.ts`. The state should track the current flow ID, step ID, and a context object for temporary data. Also, update `docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md` to document the new module.

features.title: Conversations need to be stored for user for later analytics
features.description:
Each conversation a user initiates must be stored. The user might quit his client and start fresh, so it might be possible that they will start an entirely new conversation in the middle of an ongoing one.
The best way would be simply to keep track of which flow the user received, and what was the last input they gave. This can be stored as a very simple 'log like' table that stores the id of the flow (so it can be identified later), path (so human readable identifier of the flow), the createdAt date, the userId, and the input.

features.title: Implement Unauthenticated Start Flow
features.description: Create the `start_unauthenticated` conversation flow definition. This flow will prompt the user for an `app-secret` and `access-code`. It will use the `AuthService` to validate these credentials. Upon success, it should clear the conversation state and inform the client of the successful authentication, allowing the client to then start an authenticated session.

features.title: Implement Authenticated Start Flow
features.description: Create the `start_authenticated` flow. This will serve as the main menu for a logged-in user. It should present the user with options (e.g., buttons) to navigate to the 'Update Profile', 'Goals', and 'Check-ins' flows. This feature will establish the basic pattern for a menu-like flow that transitions to other flows.

features.title: Implement Profile Setup and Update Flows
features.description: Create two flows: `setup_profile` and `update_profile`. The `setup_profile` flow guides a new user to provide their profile info, requiring at least a timezone. The `update_profile` flow allows an existing user to select a field to update and provide a new value. Both flows will use the `ProfilesService` to persist the changes.

features.title: Implement Goals Hub Flow
features.description: Create the `goals_hub` flow. This flow acts as a sub-menu for all goal-related activities. It should present the user with options to start one of the goal creation flows: 'Create from text', 'Create from audio', or 'Choose from predefined options'.

features.title: Implement Goal Creation from Predefined Options Flow
features.description: Create the `create_goal_predefined` flow. This multi-step flow will guide the user through selecting a goal type, category, and intensity. It will then fetch matching goals using the `GoalsService` and present them as options for the user to select and create.

features.title: Implement Goal Creation from Text Input Flow
features.description: Create the `create_goal_text` flow. This flow prompts the user for a text description of their goal, uses the `GoalsService` to get AI-powered suggestions, and presents them. The user can then pick a suggestion to create a goal or choose to redefine their input, restarting the prompt.

features.title: Implement Goal Creation from Audio Input Flow
features.description: Create the `create_goal_audio` flow. This flow prompts for an audio recording, uses the `TranscriptionService` to get the text, and asks the user to confirm the transcription is correct. If confirmed, it proceeds using the same logic as the `create_goal_text` flow to get and select suggestions.

features.title: Implement Check-ins Hub Flow
features.description: Create the `checkins_hub` flow. This flow will first display the user's current check-in configurations using the `CheckInsService`. It will then provide options to modify existing check-ins or set up new ones, guiding the user through the necessary steps.

features.title: Implement LLM-based Intent Detection for Starting Flows
features.description: Create a new endpoint, `POST /conversations/start`, that accepts free-form text from an authenticated user. This endpoint will use the `AIService` to interpret the user's intent and automatically start the most appropriate conversation flow (e.g., 'I want a new goal' starts the `goals_hub` flow). Implement robust error handling for cases where the intent is unclear, guiding the user to rephrase or choose from a menu.
